---
title: "USGOVT101: U.S. Constitution and Politics"
subtitle: "The Politics Professor"
---

Generic lecture materials for an introductory course on the United States Constitution and national government. No college branding, no term dates, and no commercial homework platforms.

The organizing problem: **how to live together peacefully in a society of dignified equals.**

See the README and the Lectures folder for the full sequence. There is no dedicated Texas-constitution unit. Texas appears only where it illustrates a general federalism or institutional point.
